Field Descriptions

CLK_PP_ON

Post-process pipeline clock enabled (off unless REQUANT_EN).

CLK_ADV_ON

Array/skew/delay/valid-pipe clock enabled.

CLK_W_ON

Weight shift chain clock enabled.

IDLE

Nothing in flight, no outstanding memory transactions. Safe to gate everything.
